jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II (Backend)
jobs.description: About GoKwik GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling checkout optimization, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik powers 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI-powered infrastructure across India, the UK, Europe, and the US. Why This Role Matters As an SDE 2 on the App Store & Developer Platform, you will own the system third-party developers build against and merchants install apps from. That covers OAuth and token lifecycle, app registration, scoped permissions, install and uninstall flows, webhook delivery and the public API contract developers depend on. Increasingly, it also means making the platform safe for AI agents and AI-built apps to use. Our platform is multi-tenant: one system serves many merchants, each with its own catalogue, orders, inventory, pricing and customers, and it handles millions of API calls every week. This is production engineering, not greenfield prototyping. The services you join already carry live traffic, real merchant data and third-party integrations that cannot break. The defining constraint of this role is that your API is somebody elses production dependency. A breaking change is not a deploy you can roll back quietly; it is an outage in someone elses product. You will own designs for your area, make decisions other engineers build on, run your services in production, and mentor SDE 1 engineers. What Youll Own Design & Delivery - Own the design and delivery of app-store and developer-platform services: write low-level and high-level designs, decide on APIs, data models and failure handling, and document the reasoning. OAuth & Token Lifecycle - Own OAuth 2.0 flows end to end: authorisation code with PKCE, refresh and rotation, revocation, scope enforcement and the failure modes of each. Public APIs - Build and version public APIs that external developers integrate against, with deprecation paths, contract tests and changelogs that never break live integrations. Webhook Delivery at Scale - Design and operate webhooks with HMAC signing, replay protection, retries with backoff, dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees and consumer back-pressure. Event-Driven Systems - Design and run Kafka flows: partitioning, ordering, idempotent consumers, retries, dead-letter handling and consumer lag. App Lifecycle - Own registration, review, publish, install and uninstall, and the data and permissions each transition must leave behind. Multi-Tenant Database Performance - Drive tenant-scoped queries, tenant-leading indexes, partitioning and safe expand-then-contract migrations. Caching & Rate Limiting - Use Redis deliberately for caching, distributed locking and per-app / per-merchant rate limiting. Production Reliability - Own SLOs and alerts, on-call and incident response, root-cause analysis with observability and APM tooling, and lasting fixes. AI-Ready Platform - Design APIs and tool definitions (for example, MCP servers) that LLM agents can use safely, with scoped permissions, rate limits and abuse controls. AI Developer Experience - Build LLM-backed features where they help, such as app-review assistance, docs search or integration debugging, with evals and guardrails. Reviews & Mentoring - Review critical changes, mentor SDE 1 engineers, and use AI tools across the loop while verifying everything they produce. Who You Are 3+ years of backend engineering with strong Node.js and TypeScript, with hands-on ownership of production services. Strong low-level design and working high-level design: you explain constraints, choose an approach and make accountable decisions. Multi-tenant data isolation in practice: tenant scoping on every query, cache key, job and webhook, and how to prevent and detect cross-tenant leaks. Deep relational database skills (MySQL / PostgreSQL): data modelling, transactions and isolation, indexing, reading query plans and fixing slow queries at scale. Designed and shipped APIs consumed by external parties, including versioning, deprecation and backward compatibility. Production experience with OAuth 2.0 or similar token-based authorisation, and a security mindset around tokens, scopes and secrets. Hands-on Kafka or a similar broker: consumer groups, ordering, at-least-once delivery, idempotency, dead-letter queues and lag monitoring. Distributed-systems fundamentals: idempotency, retries and backoff, rate limiting, backpressure and consistency trade-offs. Real production ownership: on-call, debugging live incidents, root-cause analysis, and monitoring with logs, metrics and traces. Solid understanding of LLM systems: tool/function calling, RAG and vector search, evals, guardrails, prompt injection, and the security implications of letting AI agents call platform APIs. Uses AI coding tools daily and productively, with the judgement to verify, test and own generated code. Clear design documentation and technical communication, with experience reviewing others work and mentoring. Treats an external contract as a promise and plans its change before it is needed; writes down the failure mode, such as what happens if a process crashes between the API call and the commit. Leads with data, acts early without waiting to be asked, and owns outcomes beyond your own tickets. Why GoKwik At GoKwik, you work on large-scale commerce infrastructure where correctness under failure, performance at scale, and code the next engineer can change safely all matter. The App Store & Developer Platform is how third-party developers extend GoKwik for merchants, so your work shapes an ecosystem that other products depend on. You get high ownership of design and production systems, real distributed-systems problems, and the chance to make a platform safe for AI agents and AI-built apps. We use AI across how we build while keeping full responsibility for what ships, in a collaborative, engineering-led environment with strong career growth potential. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 3-8 Yrs Postgresql, Distribution, Monitoring, Backend, Root cause analysis, Software development, Distribution system, Production engineering

jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION Full Stack Developer - Next.js / Node.js / AI / LLM / RAG/Python Company: Ramxora Private Limited (Ramxora.AI) Location: Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka Work Mode: Onsite Experience: 2-4 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Working Days: Monday to Friday About the Company Ramxora.AI is an AI and software product development company building modern SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, AI-powered products, automation solutions, and intelligent digital experiences. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer who can work across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and AI/LLM integrations to develop scalable, secure, and high-performance applications. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Next.js, React.js, Node.js, and AI/LLM/RAG /Python technologies . The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining complete web applications. The role requires strong frontend and backend development capabilities along with practical knowledge of integrating Large Language Models, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and AI APIs into production applications. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced product environment and collaborating with UI/UX designers, Project Managers, Technical Leads, AI/ML Engineers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams. Key Responsibilities 1. Frontend Development Develop responsive and scalable web applications using React.js and Next.js . Build reusable, maintainable, and high-performance UI components. Implement modern frontend architecture and state management. Work with Next.js routing, SSR, SSG, API routes, middleware, and server-side functionality. Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services. Implement responsive designs based on UI/UX specifications. Optimize applications for performance, SEO, accessibility, and scalability. Handle authentication, authorization, sessions, and role-based access control. Debug and resolve frontend issues across browsers and devices. 2. Backend Development Candidates with strong backend development experience in Node.js OR Python (FastAPI/Django/Flask) can be considered for the position. Develop scalable and high-performance backend applications using Python with FastAPI, Django, and Flask . Build robust RESTful APIs , backend services, and microservices for SaaS and enterprise applications. Design secure, modular, reusable, and maintainable backend architectures. Develop APIs using FastAPI with asynchronous programming, dependency injection, request validation, and automatic API documentation. Develop web applications and backend systems using Django , including Django REST Framework (DRF), ORM, middleware, authentication, and admin functionality. Develop lightweight and modular backend services using Flask and its extensions where required. Implement authentication, authorization, JWT/OAuth, role-based access control, input validation, logging, and error handling . Design and develop database models, schemas, relationships, migrations, and optimized database queries. Integrate third-party APIs, external services, payment gateways, cloud services, and enterprise systems . Develop business logic, reusable backend modules, services, utilities, and APIs for scalable SaaS applications. Optimize API performance, database queries, memory usage, and response times . Implement asynchronous programming, background tasks, job queues, scheduled jobs, and event-driven architecture where required. Work with Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka , or similar background-processing and messaging technologies. Implement proper API versioning, pagination, filtering, caching, rate limiting, and request/response handling . Write clean, modular, reusable, and well-documented Python code following PEP 8 and industry best practices . Develop and maintain unit tests, integration tests, API tests, and automated testing frameworks . Implement secure coding practices to protect backend applications against common vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication issues, and unauthorized access . Work with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud platforms, monitoring, and deployment environments . Troubleshoot production issues, analyze logs, identify root causes, and implement reliable backend solutions. Collaborate with Frontend, AI/ML, DevOps, QA, Product, and other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end applications. 2. Backend Development Develop scalable backend applications using Node.js . Build RESTful APIs and backend services. Design secure and reusable API architectures. Implement authentication, authorization, validation, logging, and error handling. Integrate third-party APIs and external services. Develop business logic and backend modules for SaaS and enterprise applications. Optimize backend performance and API response times. Work with asynchronous programming, background jobs, queues, and event-driven architecture where required. Candidates with strong backend development experience in Node.js OR Python (FastAPI/Django/Flask) can be considered for the position. 3. AI / LLM Integration Integrate LLM and Generative AI capabilities into web applications. Work with APIs from OpenAI and other LLM providers. Develop AI-powered features such as: AI assistants Chatbots Intelligent search Content generation Document analysis Summarization Question answering AI recommendations Classification and extraction Develop effective prompts and structured AI workflows. Handle LLM responses, streaming, context management, token limitations, and error handling. Integrate AI functionality into frontend and backend applications. 4. RAG Development Develop and integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications. Work with document ingestion and processing pipelines. Implement: Document parsing Text chunking Embeddings Semantic search Retrieval Context generation LLM response generation Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS , or equivalent technologies. Improve retrieval quality, relevance, latency, and response accuracy. Implement metadata filtering and hybrid search where required. Build knowledge-base and enterprise document intelligence solutions. 5. Database Development Work with MongoDB and/or MySQL/PostgreSQL . Design database schemas and data models. Develop efficient queries and indexes. Implement CRUD operations and transaction handling. Optimize database performance. Work with data relationships, aggregation, pagination, and search. Ensure data integrity and secure database access. 6. API & System Integration Develop and consume REST APIs. Integrate third-party services, payment APIs, authentication services, cloud services, and AI APIs. Work with JSON, HTTP, WebSockets, and asynchronous APIs. Implement API validation, security, rate limiting, logging, and monitoring. Coordinate with frontend, backend, AI/ML, QA, and DevOps teams for end-to-end integration. 7. Security & Performance Follow secure coding practices. Protect APIs and applications against common web vulnerabilities. Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms. Secure API keys, tokens, credentials, and sensitive information. Optimize frontend rendering, API performance, database queries, and AI response latency. Participate in code reviews and technical quality checks. 8. Testing & Debugging Write clean and testable code. Perform unit, integration, and functional testing. Debug frontend, backend, API, database, and AI integration issues. Work closely with QA teams to resolve defects. Ensure applications meet functional, performance, and security requirements. 9. Deployment & Collaboration Collaborate with DevOps engineers for application deployment and production releases. Understand basic Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and environment configuration. Work with Git and Git-based development workflows. Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings, sprint planning, code reviews, and technical discussions. Prepare technical documentation when required. Node.js Express.js or equivalent Node.js framework REST API Development Authentication & Authorization API Security Asynchronous Programming Backend Python-Candidates with strong backend development experience in Node.js OR Python (FastAPI/Django/Flask) can be considered for the position. Education Bachelor's degree or equivalent in: Computer Science Information Technology Software Engineering Artificial Intelligence Data Science Electronics / related technical field Relevant practical experience and strong technical skills may also be considered. Experience 24 years of professional experience in full-stack web development. Candidates should demonstrate practical experience with: React.js + Next.js + Node.js + Database + REST APIs and preferably hands-on experience with: AI / LLM / RAG / Embeddings / Vector Databases. Key Performance Expectations The selected candidate will be expected to: Deliver production-ready full-stack features. Build scalable frontend and backend modules. Develop reliable REST APIs. Integrate AI/LLM capabilities into applications. Build and maintain RAG-based features. Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code. Resolve technical issues efficiently.
